subject.title: feat(dashboard): add unlisted OpenClaw Bay demo

question: Should the production dashboard publish `/bay-demo` as an unauthenticated public-by-URL experiment with bounded live-only terminal and timing presentation state?
rationale: Correctness, security hardening, and browser proof cannot decide whether maintainers want to own this discoverable experimental route, its audience, and its ongoing production semantics.

options.title: Accept the experiment
options.body: Publish the unlisted and noindexed route while explicitly owning its public audience, bounded state, and live-only semantics.

options.title: Gate access
options.body: Require Cloudflare Access or application authentication before deployment if the intended audience is maintainer-only.

options.title: Pause the rollout
options.body: Keep the prototype out of production if the additional experimental surface is not worth ongoing ownership.

recommendation.title: Accept the experiment
recommendation.body: Publish the unlisted and noindexed route while explicitly owning its public audience, bounded state, and live-only semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior review and release-era dashboard history make him the strongest available owner for this deployment-boundary choice.
